title: Why the Sky Is Blue
topic: วิทยาศาสตร์
lines: Sunlight looks white, but it is actually made of all the colors of the
rainbow. Each color travels as a wave, and **they** have different lengths.
Red light has long waves, while blue light has much shorter **ones**.
When sunlight enters the Earth's atmosphere, it hits tiny particles of
gas. These particles scatter short waves much more than long waves. As a
result, blue light is spread across the whole sky, and **that** is the
color we see when we look up on a clear day.
But why is the sky not violet, which has even shorter waves than blue?
